title: TITLE: THE FIGHT CAN BE SEEN BEHIND THE SCOREBOARD AND HOW-TO PAGES
why: His answers Q52 and Q54: the live map with real combat behind the title, scoreboard and how-to pages. The fight was drawn but a 16px blur and a 90 percent edge scrim hid it, and it stood low in the dark corner. Floor labels and the HUD are not drawn behind the attract pages now, so the blur drops to 5px and the scrim to about 60 percent at the edges, and the fights stand at mid height in the side margins.
now: The fight behind the scoreboard and how-to can be seen.
